node.title: Exact far-CA anchor-pencil normal form
node.statement: For every linear code and column-far pair at radius r, fixing one bad slope with error e_0 of support size s gives an exact parametrization of every other bad slope as gamma_0+lambda with a codeword p satisfying wt(e_0+lambda(f_2-p))<=r. If t is the number of off-anchor discrepancies of p, then r-s+1<=t<=r and at least s+t-r anchor coordinates satisfy p=f_2+e_0/lambda. When 2r<d_min, p is unique per slope. This uniqueness holds throughout the first official post-quadratic CA-only range.
